description: Fictional documents for an internal retrieval feasibility pilot. No customer or production data.

chunks.title: Beacon release rollback
chunks.content: To roll back a Beacon release, select the previous signed deployment in the console and confirm the rollback. Verify the health check after the switch.

chunks.title: Beacon release approval
chunks.content: Beacon production releases require approval from the service owner before deployment. Staging releases do not require this approval.

chunks.title: Coral key rotation
chunks.content: Rotate a Coral API key by creating a replacement, updating clients, and revoking the old key only after all clients have migrated.

chunks.title: Coral incident response
chunks.content: For suspected key exposure, immediately revoke the affected Coral API key and notify the incident lead. The planned rotation overlap does not apply to exposed keys.

chunks.title: Delta retention policy
chunks.content: Delta retains execution logs for 30 days. Export an approved incident record before the retention period ends if an investigation requires it.

chunks.title: Delta health checks
chunks.content: The Delta health endpoint reports whether the service is ready to receive requests. It does not report log-retention settings.
